flags.stem_preview: In Dragon Ball Z's Cell saga, the bio-android Cell achieves his perfect form by absorbing Android 17 and Android 18 — both products of the late Dr. Gero's lab. flags.stem_preview: On July 4, 1982, a 17-year-old Florida pizza-parlor owner named Billy Mitchell achieved the first verified score over 1,000,000 points in Donkey Kong. What was his exact score?
flags.issue: Logical/factual contradiction. Stem claims Mitchell achieved 'the first verified score over 1,000,000 points' but the answer is 874,300 — a sub-million score. The 874,300 was Mitchell's record at the time, but it's NOT a million. Mitchell didn't pass 1M until later (claimed 1,047,200 in 2007). Also: Mitchell was not 17 in 1982 (born July 16, 1965 — making him 16, and the claim 'pizza-parlor owner' at age 17 in 1982 is age-anachronistic; he was a teenager working at his father's restaurant).
flags.suggested_fix: Rewrite: 'On July 4, 1982, Billy Mitchell set a then-world-record Donkey Kong score at his family's Florida arcade. What was the score?' → '874,300.' Drop the 'over 1,000,000' framing entirely.
